volume_thresholds._basis: ratio to the mean volume of the previous lookback_bars completed bars
volume_thresholds._upthrust_basis: Spring and Upthrust are typed by DIFFERENT tables in the book: Bảng 2.1 (WMT p049, Spring) runs low->type1 / moderate->type2 / high->type3, but Bảng 2.2 (WMT p064, Upthrust) runs the other way -- type1 'increases at the touch', type2 (UTAD) 'very high', type3 (Minor UTAD) 'strong but not as high as type 2'. There is NO low-volume Upthrust in the book. `upthrust_min_ratio` is the floor at which volume counts as having 'increased at the touch'; below it the bar is not any of the book's three Upthrust types and is refused rather than relabelled. Fixed 2026-09-19 after a knowledge audit found the Spring ladder being applied to shorts (knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md:55-72).

displacement._basis: 'displacement is an aggressive move with full-bodied candles' (knowledge/ict/core-a.md section 2.16). Read as: body >= body_min_ratio of the candle range AND range >= range_min_median_ratio x the median bar range of the window. An MSS whose breaking candle fails this is reported as 'close beyond swing without displacement'.

Values read from mutable files are captured here BY VALUE, so a later edit to risk-config.json or analysis-params.json cannot silently change what a recorded result says it measured.
